message.reasoning:
The user asks: "When was the declaration of independence signed?" They want the date when the Declaration of Independence was signed. Historically, the Declaration of Independence was adopted on July 4, 1776, but the signing ceremony took place on August 2, 1776. Many people think it was signed on July 4, but actually the signing happened later. The question likely expects the answer: July 4, 1776 (adopted) or August 2, 1776 (signed). The user didn't specify which date they want. We can provide both dates and clarify.
